# Susan Atelier — Full Product Catalog for AI Crawlers

## Brand Overview
Susan Atelier is a prelaunch Indian occasion wear brand founded by Riya in 2026.
Tagline: "Made by named hands, worn for years, not seasons."
Every piece is hand-embroidered by named artisans across 4 ateliers in India.
Transparent pricing: every product shows fabric cost, artisan wage, and MRP breakdown.

## Brand Values
- Handcrafted — every stitch by a named human
- Contemporary — current silhouettes, never costume
- Artisanal — traditional embroidery techniques
- Feminine — botanical motifs from the founder's garden
- Timeless — meant to be worn for years, not one occasion

## The Collection (17 pieces)
All pieces are one-of-a-kind, already made and finished.
When it's gone, it's gone. No restocks.

## Transparency Card (per product)
Every product shows:
- The Maker: artisan name + workshop location + years at the frame
- The Cloth: exact fabric composition
- The Embroidery: technique description
- Fair Wage: exact amount paid + comparison to living wage (₹300/day)
- Cost Breakdown: fabric + embroidery + stitching = cost → MRP

## Size Guide
Sizes: XXS, XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL, 4XL
Measurements in centimetres: Bust, Waist, Hip
Free size exchange on every piece
If between sizes, size up — pieces are cut to drape
